presenting_problem:
I am experiencing feelings of anxiety and self-doubt after a recent party I organized did not go as planned.
These feelings started after the failed party, which occurred about a month ago.
The stress level was high during the event as I felt responsible for the negative outcome.
Since then, I have noticed increased anxiety when planning events and a decrease in confidence in my abilities.
I tend to catastrophize and jump to conclusions, believing that I will never be trusted to organize events again.
These feelings occur mostly when I have to plan events or interact with clients.
I have tried talking to friends and taking short breaks but the anxiety persists.
reason_seeking_counseling: I realized that my anxiety and self-doubt were affecting my professional performance and wanted to address these issues before they escalate further.
patterns: black-and-white or polarized thinking / all or nothing thinking
